items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. This is the only travel charge on the plumbing invoice; the gross benchmark is €81.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material needed for the local supply-pipe repair. The benchmark for the one billed piece is €26 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) support like-for-like replacement of the failed indoor supply-pipe section. One metre is estimated at €40 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the insulation on the repaired section to its pre-loss specification. One metre is estimated at €23 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour, but §7.1.8(c) bars overlap with the separately billed technician time. If this is a distinct hour, the closely matching bathroom repair in Case 39 supports €76 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the reasonable labour needed to access and repair the failed pipe. Case 39 supports approximately €83 per unit for nine comparable units, or €747 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) allow necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. The single deployment is estimated at €548 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed patch. The €588 gross benchmark is for local reinstatement only.

items.description: Full repaint of the affected wall
items.rationale: Section 7.1.6 does not extend cover to the undamaged portion because matching paint is still available, and the patch is already billed on line 8. If the full 8 m² were eligible, €18/m² would give €144 gross.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate, undamaged surfaces for visual matching. The conditional €400 gross estimate is for the full flat-rate repaint, not an expected payment.
